svg.aria-label: How this newsletter is delivered. The signup form on joekarlsson.com talks over HTTPS to a Cloudflare Tunnel with CrowdSec, which opens no ports at home and makes only the subscriber pages public. Inside the homelab on Proxmox, Nginx Proxy Manager answers the admin side with a 404 from the internet, and listmonk and Postgres run in one LXC container built by OpenTofu and backed up to Proxmox Backup Server. The 141 subscribers came in from a Substack CSV export, and the admin UI works only from the home network. listmonk sends over SMTP through Brevo's free plan, 300 emails a day shared with critical alerts and a Plex newsletter, to your inbox, where a reply comes straight to Joe.
